status: generated: 25 species including the hidden owl; integrated into the bird atlas
referenceRole: Style reference only. Create a new individual illustration for each species.
sharedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: bird encyclopedia game sprite. Create exactly one bird of the specified species, using the supplied reference's chunky low-resolution pixel sticker style. Full body in a side or three-quarter view; rounded simplified silhouette, dark stepped pixel outlines, thick continuous white sticker border, a small restrained palette with crisp square pixel clusters. Keep identifying plumage, bill, legs and tail recognizable. Center the entire bird with generous margins on a flat muted blue-gray background matching the reference. Square composition, consistent apparent pixel size across the collection. No text, labels, watermarks, frame, other birds, scenery, gradients, smooth vector curves, blur or photorealistic textures. Do not crop the feet, bill, crest, wings or tail.

delivery.resampling: nearest-neighbor after inspecting the generated pixel grid
delivery.review: Inspect every species for identity, complete body, reference-style pixel grid and consistent white border; review a contact sheet and desktop/mobile atlas.

integration.atlas: Use the new assets/world/birds/{id}.png only for bird encyclopedia artwork. Compute progress from the catalog length.
integration.groupChat: Keep assets/world/bulbul.png, robin.png, egret.png and kingfisher.png byte-for-byte unchanged. Keep Dianya's group messages using these original photos and original four species.
integration.otherArt: Keep the four existing art entries and their assets unchanged.
integration.saves: Preserve existing bird IDs and unlocks. Expand entry validation for the new catalog.
integration.collection: Keep the first four quest bird unlocks. Twenty additional species are discoverable on daytime revisits. The hidden collared scops owl unlocks only in the fifth and final nighttime Baiyun Mountain quest.
integration.activation: Do not activate new atlas paths or catalog entries until all required artwork exists and has been reviewed.
